title: RERN: Rich Edge Features Refinement Detection Network for Polycrystalline Solar Cell Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Edge-detection formulation of defect segmentation with bidirectional strip refinement attention (long-range horizontal and vertical context plus channel context), lightweight and pluggable; evaluated with tolerance-based ODS F-measure.
adaptation: Insert strip attention into the last two U-Net++ decoder stages; aimed at gridline (recall 0.33, long straight lines) and long cracks. Use their tolerant ODS/OIS idea as a benchmark crack metric alongside relF1@2.
min_experiment: Arm house + strip attention vs house, 5 seeds; gridline IoU/recall and crack relF1@2; kill if gridline IoU < +0.03 and crack relF1@2 not up.
evidence: R: ODS F 0.854 on their PSCDE poly-Si defect edge dataset at maxDist 0.0015; BSRA also improved other edge networks on PSCDE.
prior_overlap: none: edge-detection formulations and strip attention never tried.

alt_notes.adaptation: Insert BSRA (directional strip pooling) into U-Net++ decoder blocks and train crack with class-balanced edge BCE. For the benchmark, report ODS/OIS at maxDist = 2 px alongside relF1@2.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: U-Net++ + BSRA. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: relF1@2, crack components >= 20 px found. Kill if relF1@2 < +0.01.
